title: Compliance with code.
officialText:
Permits shall be deemed to incorporate the provisions that the applicant, the owner, their
agents, employees, and contractors shall carry out the permitted work in accordance with the provisions of this code and other
applicable laws or rules, whether specified or not, except as variations have been legally permitted or authorized.
